notes: Monthly ISSUED-permit reports: every row maps to normalizedStage permit_issued. Rows carry owner AND contractor names plus a stated value — the value is mapped to valuationUsd (unlike permit-fee fields elsewhere) because the column is the project value the city itself totals per month. D1 invariant reconciles the parsed sum against that printed total per artifact.
